"""Host render of the actual LVGL UI. Requires gcc/g++, ar and Pillow."""
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import io
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from PIL import Image

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
lvgl=root/'.pio/libdeps/es3c28p/lvgl'
build=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();build.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
flags=['-O1','-DLV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE','-I'+str(root/'include'),'-I'+str(root/'src'),'-I'+str(lvgl)]
sources=list((lvgl/'src').rglob('*.c'))+list((root/'src/fonts').glob('*.c'))
def compile_source(p):
    obj=build/(str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('/','_')+'.o')
    if not obj.exists() or obj.stat().st_mtime<p.stat().st_mtime:
        subprocess.run(['gcc',*flags,'-c',str(p),'-o',str(obj)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    return str(obj)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool: objects=list(pool.map(compile_source,sources))
subprocess.run(['ar','rcs',str(build/'libpreview.a'),*objects],check=True)
subprocess.run(['g++','-std=c++17',*flags,str(root/'tests/ui_preview.cpp'),str(root/'src/LvglUI.cpp'),str(root/'src/TimeEditor.cpp'),str(build/'libpreview.a'),'-lm','-o',str(build/'preview')],check=True)
source=(root/'src/Artwork.h').read_text()
for name in re.findall(r'const uint8_t jpg_(\w+)\[\] PROGMEM',source):
    values=re.search(r'const uint8_t jpg_'+name+r'\[\] PROGMEM = \{(.*?)\};',source,re.S).group(1)
    jpeg=bytes(map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',values)))
    im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpeg)).convert('RGB');raw=bytearray()
    for r,g,b in im.getdata():raw+=(((r>>3)<<11)|((g>>2)<<5)|(b>>3)).to_bytes(2,'little')
    (build/(name+'.rgb565')).write_bytes(raw)
subprocess.run([str(build/'preview'),str(build/'normal.rgb565'),str(build)],check=True)
for path in build.glob('*.ppm'):
    Image.open(path).save(path.with_suffix('.png'))

README.md:
# Peppiuhr

ESP32-S3 ES3C28P, 320×240 capacitive display, 16 MB flash, LVGL 9.5. Countdown modes, clock, Wi-Fi/web configuration, SD/MP3 and DE/PL/EN interface.

## Firmware v1.19.11

User-controlled OTA: **check → read release notes → confirm install**. Updates come from this repository's latest published release. There is no background update check or automatic installation.

The first OTA-enabled version must be flashed via USB using `firmware-merged.bin` at address `0x0`. Future OTA uses **only `firmware.bin`**, never the merged image. See [installation and changes](docs/CHANGELOG-v1.19.11.md).

The clock needs internet access through home Wi-Fi and a correct date for HTTPS certificate validation. Its own captive hotspot alone is insufficient. SD artwork and user settings are not distributed in OTA images.

## Build

```sh
python -m pip install platformio==6.2.0 esptool==5.1.0
pio run -e es3c28p
python tools/package_release.py
```

Pinned platform: pioarduino 55.03.32 / Arduino ESP32 3.3.2. Partition table has two 7 MiB application slots. Outputs are in `dist/`. Generated fonts and fallback artwork are included in the source for a reproducible build; external SD artwork is deliberately omitted from release ZIPs.

GitHub Actions builds and tests the source on pushes and pull requests. Publication is a separate explicit operation. Release assets must include `firmware.bin` and `ota.json` with matching SHA-256, byte size and version tag. Publish the complete release only after uploading both; do not replace binaries of an already published version. Build a new version instead.

## Validation limits

Compilation and host tests do not replace physical testing. OTA download, power-loss recovery, restart, audio/display/touch behaviour and bootloader rollback still require device validation. HTTPS and SHA-256 are enabled; firmware signatures and secure boot are not configured by this release.
docs/CHANGELOG-v1.19.11.md:
# Peppiuhr v1.19.11

- Ikona baterii na ekranie ustawień otwiera panel z przełącznikiem widoczności.
- Wybór zapisuje się od razu w NVS i pozostaje po restarcie. Domyślnie wyłączony.
- Opcjonalny wskaźnik na ekranie odliczania, prawy górny róg: bateria i procent.
- Pomiar GPIO9 z dzielnikiem 200k/200k, uśrednianie próbek i filtrowanie co 5 sekund.
- Procent jest przybliżeniem dla pojedynczego akumulatora Li-ion 3,7 V. Niski poziom wyróżniony kolorem.
- Brak automatycznego rozpoznawania obecności baterii i ładowania; przy braku baterii wyłącz wskaźnik.
- DE/PL/EN, złote obramowania oraz pięć równomiernie rozmieszczonych ikon ustawień.

OTA: bin/firmware.bin. USB: bin/firmware-merged.bin, adres 0x0. Pliki SD bez zmian.
Pomiar i układ ekranu wymagają sprawdzenia na urządzeniu.
